messages:
kevin: PR #5901 needs a tiny, customer-facing update: 1) one-line allowance formula, 2) a compact JS snippet for minutes->allowance, 3) a one-line migration note for legacy meter headers, 4) a minimal alert YAML (percent_of_daily). Keep everything short. cc @sasha
sasha: I got the JS snippet and alert YAML. Will avoid internal links and keep locale notes short. Draft JS (3 lines):```js
// minutes -> floored allowance
const allowance = (per_min, mins) => Math.floor(per_min * mins);
console.log(allowance(200, 10)) // 2000
```
kevin: Good. Migration one-liner: "Legacy meter header users: map to X-Redwood-Usage-Tier and recompute per_min/per_day allowances."
sasha: Alert YAML (minimal):```yaml
when: usage.percent_of_daily >= 80
window: 1h
action: notify:billing
notes: percent rounded to nearest int; burst credits excluded until consumed
```
docs-bot: l10n-check queued for PR #5901. Please mark locale-sensitive currency examples for review.
kevin: Action: sasha - push snippets + migration line; i'll merge after docs-bot passes. Thanks! :white_check_mark:
